 Live Last update 10:33 PM ET 10:33 PM ET a few seconds ago 1Q | 2:10: Momentum swings on the hardwood in the 1st quarter
 Charles Bassey cleaned up the offensive glass with a putback, before Jordan Goodwin knocked down a jumper off an assist from Luke Kennard . Moments later, Oso Ighodaro finished through traffic inside off an assist from Devin Booker and Collin Gillespie splashed a deep 27-foot triple off a crisp feed from Jordan Goodwin , leaving the scoreboard at Suns 25, Warriors 15 with 2:10 remaining in the 1st Quarter.
